title: Zen Residences at Muscat Bay
body: Zen Development and Investment LLC announced a strategic partnership with Al Adrak Trading & Contracting Co. LLC, formalized during a signing ceremony at the Muscat Bay sales centre, appointing Al Adrak as the main contractor for the highly anticipated Zen Residences project within the prestigious Muscat Bay.

This partnership underscores both companies’ commitment to excellence and their shared vision for delivering high-quality living spaces. The development will comprise of five buildings featuring a range of living options, including studios, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as lofts, each designed to provide an optimal living experience.

Zen Residences will boast a range of modern amenities and features designed to enhance the living experience for its residents. These include an infinity pool that offers serene relaxation, an outdoor BBQ area ideal for social gatherings, and an outdoor gym tailored for health enthusiasts. Additionally, the development features a dedicated kids’ play area, a scenic running track, and a tranquil Zen garden, all crafted to enrich resident lifestyles.

title: Adrak Developers and Ministry of Housing & Urban P
body: Adrak Developers and Ministry of Housing & Urban Planning sign Development Agreement for Sultan Haitham City’s Neighborhood 12 D

Adrak Developers LLC is pleased to announce a significant partnership with the Ministry of Housing & Urban Planning for the development of Neighborhood 12 D (NH 12 D) within Sultan Haitham City. The signing of the development agreement took place at the Oman Design & Build Exhibition 2024 held at the Oman Convention & Exhibition Centre. The project signifies a commitment to redefining luxury living in Muscat. NH 12 D will encompass over 300 high-end residential units spread across a land area of 56,166 square meters. With an estimated investment value of OMR 38.7 million, the development promises to be a landmark addition to Sultan Haitham City.

His Excellency Dr. Khalfan bin Said Al Shueili, Minister of Housing and Urban Planning, emphasizes that the Ministry is delighted to collaborate with Adrak Developers on Neighborhood 12 D, as the project perfectly aligns with their vision for Sultan Haitham City by fostering a vibrant community and offering residents a world-class living experience, ultimately contributing significantly to Muscat’s growth and prosperity.

title: MTDI to master plan NH 12 D residential project
body: Adrak Developers has appointed MTDI, a globally acclaimed architectural and design group, to masterplan the Neighbourhood 12 D (NH 12 D) luxury residential project within Sultan Haitham City in Oman’s capital, Muscat.

Marek Tryzybowicz Design International Group (MTDI Group) based in Poland brings a wealth of experience and international recognition to the project. With a proven track record of designing award-winning spaces around the world, MTDI is renowned for its innovative approach, focus on sustainability, and commitment to creating places that nurture human connection.
Spread over an area of 56,000 sqm, NH 12 D will encompass over 300 luxurious apartment buildings and a central plaza hosting a dedicated commercial area featuring restaurants and other amenities.

title: Sultan Haitham City : A New Milestone in Urban Dev
body: Adrak Developers LLC is excited to announce a significant partnership with the Ministry of Housing & Urban Planning for the launch of Sultan Haitham City. This monumental project marks a new era in urban development and community building in the Sultanate of Oman.

The signing of the Term Sheet for NH 12 D, which comprises 339 residential units spread across 56,000 square meters, took place in the esteemed presence of key dignitaries. His Highness Sayyid Theyazin Bin Haitham Al Said, Minister of Culture, Sports, and Youth, along with His Excellency Dr. Khalfan Al Shuaili, Minister of Housing & Urban Planning, graced the occasion, highlighting the significance of this partnership for the nation.

title: Bandar Al Khairan Resort Project Launched
body: A ceremony was held on January 29, 2024, to celebrate the commencement of construction works for the Bandar Al Khairan Resort in the presence of Salem Bin Mohammed Al Mahrouqi, the Minister of Heritage and Tourism. Agreements were signed with Al Adrak Trading & Contracting, the main contractor of the project, during the ceremony.

The resort, which is being built at a cost of OMR36 million over an area of 189,000 sqm, has been meticulously designed to enhance the tourism sector in the Sultanate of Oman. With a total exploited area of 49,000 sqm, the resort will feature 121 hotel rooms, restaurants, and facilities catering to the comfort of visitors with diverse tastes. Against the backdrop of stunning views and a charming atmosphere, guests will be treated to an unforgettable experience.

title: Business Leader of the Year 2023 - Dr. Aadil Thoma
body: In a momentous occasion highlighting outstanding leadership and exceptional businesses, our Executive Director, Dr. Aadil Thomas Alexander, was honored with the prestigious Business Leader of the Year Award at the TAS Business Awards 2023. The esteemed Governor of Muscat, His Excellency Sayyid Saud bin Hilal Al Busaidi, presented the accolade in recognition of Dr. Aadil's outstanding contributions to the Business Community. The TAS Business Awards, dedicated to spotlighting excellence, serve as a platform for celebrating and inspiring remarkable individuals and enterprises.

title: Dossier Construction Awards 2023
body: In the spotlight of the Dossier Construction Awards 2023, our success story unfolds with not one but two remarkable victories.

Our Chairman & CED, Dr. Thomas Alexander, has been honored as the "Iconic Business Leader of the Year 2023." His visionary approach and unwavering commitment have not only guided us through challenges but have also set a standard for excellence in leadership.

The spotlight also shines on our commitment to exceptional living spaces with the "Best Real Estate Project - Residential" award for the Hai Al Naseem Project. This accolade reaffirms our dedication to creating homes that transcend expectations.
Grateful to His Excellency Ahmed Mohammed Al Humaidi, the Chairman of the Muscat Municipality, these awards are a testament to our team's hard work and the support of our clients.

title: Aloft Hotel Muscat Wins MEED Project Award for Exc
body: Aloft Hotel Muscat has achieved a significant milestone by being named the national winner in the Hotel Project of the Year category at the MEED Project Awards held in Dubai. The prestigious award was gracefully accepted by our Executive Director, Dr. Aadil Thomas Alexander, underscoring his exemplary leadership at the forefront. This recognition underlines the hotel's unwavering commitment to innovation, sustainability, and societal impact in the MENA region, positioning it as a trailblazer in the industry. The MEED Projects Awards, renowned for honoring top-tier projects in construction, infrastructure, and utilities across the MENA region, solidify Aloft Hotel Muscat's excellence in the dynamic hospitality landscape. With 199 modern loft-style guestrooms, meticulously designed for the next generation of travelers, the hotel offers a captivating experience with diverse spaces, distinctive design and lively live music events.

title: OCCI establishes Foreign Investors Committee
body: We are delighted to announce a significant milestone for our esteemed leader, Dr. Thomas Alexander. In recognition of his exceptional leadership and expertise, Dr. Alexander has been nominated to serve on the distinguished Foreign Investors Committee by the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI).

As the Founder and Chief Executive Director of our organization, Dr. Alexander's nomination underscores his profound impact and influence in shaping economic discussions in Oman. Serving as a nominated member for the period 2023 to 2026, Dr. Alexander will undoubtedly bring valuable insights and a wealth of experience to this crucial committee. We extend our heartfelt congratulations to Dr. Thomas Alexander on this well-deserved recognition. We are confident that, as a committee member, he will contribute effectively, addressing challenges and promoting positive developments within the private sector.

title: Adrak Developers marks First Key Handove
body: We are delighted to announce the successful key handover to our first customer at Hai Al Naseem. This marks a momentous occasion, symbolizing the achievement of dedicated efforts, a commitment to quality, and customer satisfaction. We extend our sincere thanks and appreciation to our dedicated team members who have worked tirelessly to ensure the highest standards of quality in every aspect of the project. Their commitment to excellence has significantly contributed to the satisfaction of our first customer. As we celebrate this significant milestone, we eagerly anticipate continuing this success by handing over more keys in the coming days. Thank you for your trust in Adrak Developers.

title: Wellness Waves in Muscat: Health Campaign at Al Ad
body: In a proactive move towards employee well-being, Al Adrak collaborated with Adlife Hospital for a Health Check-Up Campaign that swept through both the company's head office and site locations in Muscat. The campaign offered comprehensive health screenings, from vital signs to specialized assessments, tailored to address occupational health concerns. The positive impact was evident, with early detections and personalized health advice empowering individuals to take charge of their well-being. Adlife Hospital's campaign not only marked a moment of health awareness but also initiated a cultural shift towards prioritizing wellness at Al Adrak group Companies in Muscat

title: Al Adrak's Dubai Journey: EH3 Groundbreaking Cerem
body: We are thrilled to share the exciting news of the groundbreaking ceremony for Al Adrak's first major project in Dubai. The event marked a significant milestone as it initiated the construction of Ellington House 3 (EH3), a G + 1P + 9 storey Residential Building in Dubai Hills Estate, with a built-up area of 24,772 sqm. This marks the beginning of a transformative journey for Al Adrak, and we look forward to constructing more residences and high-rise buildings that not only redefine modern living in Dubai but also reflect our commitment to architectural excellence and sustainability.

title: In-Country Value (ICV)
body: At Al Adrak, we understand our responsibility to our community and believe in the concept of 'In Country Value' (ICV). We are firmly devoted to contributing to our country's commercial progress, promoting the development of Omani capabilities, and boosting productivity in Oman's economy. Our ICV approach is important to our day-to-day operations and efforts, and it is a significant driver of our total productivity."
Our Vision:To stimulate business productivity in Oman and to play a significant role in the development of Omani people's capabilities

title: AL TAMKEEN INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL
body: With the proven history of handing over fast-track projects within Client's required time and in quality, Al Tamkeen International School LLC, on 15.09.2022, has selected Al Adrak to build an international school in Al Khoudh, a town in the Muscat Governorate that is part of the Seeb Wilayat in northeastern Oman. It is a 6-Storey building with international school facilities in a total built-up area of 32,489.92 sqm and the scope of works include complete civil and the MEP works.

title: RECOGNITION AWARD FOR ADRAK DEVELOPERS
body: Adrak Developers, the leading real-estate firm in the Sultanate of Oman, on 15.06.2022has been awarded for enhancing and supporting the sustainable growth of Oman’s Vision 2040, presented by H.H. Sayyid Marwan Bin Turki Al Said to our CED, Dr. Thomas Alexander, in the presence of H.E. Ridha Juma Al Saleh, OCCI Chairman and other dignitaries at Muscat Real Estate Development Forum.

title: COMMUNITY FACILITY & LABOUR ACCOMMODATION AT KHAZA
body: Al Adrak Trading and Contracting LLC partnering with Adrak Developers and Insight Engineering Consultants, on 12.06.2022have commenced the construction works of community facility and labour accommodations at Khazaen Economic City, the Sultanate's largest public-private partnership project for the construction, management, and development of economic zones. The city is being built in Barka, South Batinah Governorate, and is strategically located near Muscat, the capital. The complete civil and associated MEP works with a total built-up area of 18,654.33 sqm are included in the current scope of works. This design and build project includes the development of labour accommodation, different commercial structures, as well as a mosque and an imam's residence, and has around 40% of the plot green coverage.

title: PUBLIC PROSECUTION AUTHORITY BUILDING  AT BAUSHER,
body: Another high-end finished government project, the Public Prosecution Head Office Building in Muscat Governorate, Bushar with a land area of 23,953 square meters in Madinat Al-Erfaan, was awarded on 05.04.2022 and added to Al Adrak portfolio. The scope comprises complete civil, structural, interior finishes, facade and all associated MEPF works with a total built-up area of 38,829 sqm. The 6-Storey building's exterior is covered in stone cladding and the structure is built on different levels, giving it an elegant and modern appearance.

title: Golden Achievement Award Dubai 2020
body: Our CED Dr. Thomas Alexander has been honored with the prestigious Golden Achievement Award Dubai during the 6th Edition 2020 on 21st February 2021.
Due to pandemic the award ceremony was conducted virtually and attended by dignitaries.

title: Extension of Ahli Bank Corporate Office Phase 3 &
body: Al Adrak Trading & Contractor LLC has clinched the title of Main Contractor for the construction of “Extension of Ahli Bank Corporate Office Phase 3 & 4” at Wattayah.
Al Adrak’s immense experience and expertise in executing the Projects ahead of Schedule have paved the way for securing this prestigious job.

The project comprises of construction, completion and Maintenance of G+5 Ahli Bank Head office and a G+5 Multi-Level Car Parking Building including all Civil, MEP and External Works integrated to the existing Ahli Bank Headquarters.
